inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted average for H1 FY2026 (1,076.196m basic, which already nets out share-award-trust holdings and the 15.84m treasury shares bought back Jan-2026, plus 2.423m dilutive restricted shares); H1 2026 Interim note 8. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report cash flow statement, 'Expense recognised in respect of share award scheme' RMB231,408k (FY2024 294,719k). No equity-award tax withholding line exists (awards are satisfied from trust-held shares bought on market: RMB47.1m FY2025, RMB298.4m FY2024).
inputs.fx_note: Model in CNY (RMB statements); quote in HKD. fx_rate = HKD per CNY = 1.1724, Yahoo CNYHKD=X regularMarketTime 2026-10-16T22:01Z (52w range 1.0825-1.1733). Direction check: the Jan-2026 buyback cost HKD1,015.5m (interim report) and was booked as RMB915.2m in the H1 2026 cash flow, implying 1.110 HKD/CNY then -- same direction, magnitude consistent with the CNY's rise since. No A-share or other dual listing exists for a price parity check.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo Finance chart API
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' own currency: 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.15 x China ERP ~6.5% = ~9.3%, rounded to 9.5%. Net cash balance sheet, so WACC = cost of equity. Same WACC in every scenario: cyclicality, customer concentration and US-China export-control risk are priced in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate. Terminal growth 2.0% base (below RMB nominal GDP, ~in line with long CGB yield).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB163.7m (50.2 current + 113.4 non-current, 30-Jun-2026) included in total_debt; lease principal (~RMB54m/yr) NOT deducted from flows; ROU depreciation (~RMB70m) sits inside D&A. Immaterial either way (~0.4% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: NCI took 3.5% of FY2025 profit and 7.3% of H1 2026 profit (vehicle subsidiary Sunny Smart Autotech; spin-off IPO pending). Folded into cash_tax_rate_path as a combined tax+NCI leakage: base 1-(1-12%)(1-6%) = 17.3% ramping to 1-(1-14%)(1-6%) = 19.2%. NO NCI deduction in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 EBIT ex-gain ~RMB4,160m x (1-17.3%) = ~3,440m vs attributable NPAT ex-swap-gain ex-net-treasury-income ex-associates ~3,410m.
inputs.cash_treatment: JUDGMENT. Latest balance sheet (30-Jun-2026, seasonal trough after payables unwind): cash 3,499.1 + short-term fixed deposits 1,685.3 + pledged 14.8 + time deposits 1,687.3 current + 505.4 non-current + current FVTPL unlisted financial products (bank wealth-management products, the kpis 'ShortTermInvestments' pile) 13,326.5 = RMB20,718.4m gross liquidity. The FVTPL products are short-tenor bank products rolled continuously (RMB38-43bn purchased and redeemed per year) and their yield is reported outside OCF, so they are treated as cash at carrying value. RMB3,000m (~6.5% of TTM revenue, roughly one month of cost of sales) is held back as operating float -- a ~RMB45bn-revenue manufacturer with RMB16bn of trade payables (incl. supplier notes financing) needs a working balance, and trade payables swing ~RMB5bn intra-year. Surplus liquidity counted = 17,718.4; less bank borrowings 3,089.9 + bonds 2,798.0 + leases 163.7 = 6,051.5 debt; net cash = RMB11,666.9m (~RMB10.8/share). Not haircut for PRC dividend withholding (5-10%) on repatriation to the Cayman parent; that would cost ~RMB0.5-1.0/share.
inputs.one_off_normalisation: FY2025 metrics EBITDA RMB8,062.6m includes the RMB918.9m non-cash gain on the Goertek Optical share swap (Note 35), RMB601m of treasury income and RMB172m share of associates. Underlying EBITDA rebuilt from the cash flow statement: PBT 5,416.0 - associates 171.6 - swap gain 918.9 - interest income 272.7 - FVTPL investment income 328.5 + finance costs 436.2 + D&A 2,382.0 = RMB6,542.5m post-SBC, 6,773.9m pre-SBC = 15.7% margin (FY2024 same basis 13.8%; H1 2026 ~16.0%). The swap gain does NOT touch the FCF base: it is reversed as a non-cash item inside OCF, so reported FCF 3,148.5 needs only the SBC deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (CNY flows, HKD quote, NCI, matching-asset bridge). Sunny is an operating manufacturer (handset lens sets/camera modules ~63% of revenue, vehicle optics ~17%, XR ~6%, other/robotics ~14%); routing table row 2. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry). OWNER FCF: reported FCF = OCF 6,079.5 - capex 2,931.0 (PPE 2,113.8 + deposits/prepayments for PPE and land 779.7 + intangibles 37.4) = 3,148.5; less SBC 231.4 = 2,917.1. Interest income is NOT deducted because Sunny classifies 'interest and investment income received' in INVESTING and interest paid in FINANCING, so OCF already excludes treasury income (FY2025: interest 272.7 + WMP income 328.5); the source assets are in the net-cash figure instead, satisfying the matching-asset rule. EQUITY BRIDGE: interests in associates (incl. the 31.31% Goertek Optical stake received in Dec-2025, booked at fair value at the swap) 3,893.2 + FVTOCI equity 226.5 + non-current FVTPL 139.0 at book; their income (share of associates RMB172m FY25, -RMB5m H1 26) is excluded from the EBITDA path. BUYBACKS: a funded flat count -- RMB915.2m (15.84m shares at avg HK$64.11) repurchased Jan-2026 into treasury to satisfy future awards, plus trust purchases RMB47.1m FY2025 / 298.4m FY2024. HORIZON: 10 years from FY2025 base; FY2026 (H1 +11.5%) is discounted a full year although the valuation date is October 2026, a mild conservatism (~4% of value). Historical revenue segments break in FY2025 (Handset-related/Vehicle-related/AR-VR -> Handset/Vehicle/XR/Other); growth paths are set on group revenue, not segment-summed.

equity_bridge.item: Interests in associates (incl. 31.31% Goertek Optical) at book
equity_bridge.note: H1 2026 Interim balance sheet, note 12; income excluded from flows

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 11.9% vs revenue 5yr 2.6% and EPS 5yr -0.9%: book has compounded on retained earnings while the business went through the 2021-23 smartphone downcycle (revenue 38.0bn FY2020 -> 31.7bn FY2023 -> 43.2bn FY2025). Equity CAGR is not a usable revenue-growth proxy here; the 3yr revenue CAGR (trough-to-recovery) is selected and the base path decays well below it.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF (reported FCF less SBC) CAGRs are negative on both windows because FY2020-22 OCF was flattered by working-capital release in the downcycle and FY2025 capex stepped up (overseas capacity, deposits RMB780m). SBC is small (0.5% of revenue) so the owner and reported CAGRs differ by under 1pp -- SBC is not funding the growth.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 9% against H1 +11.5%: H2 carries the memory-chip-driven smartphone unit decline (IDC -5.3% H1). Then decays from vehicle/ADAS content growth and Pan-IoT/robotics toward ~3.5% by year 10 as handset (63%) stays flat-to-low-single-digit.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Pre-SBC underlying margin 15.7% FY2025 (13.8% FY2024, ~16.0% H1 2026, 19-20% at the FY2020-21 peak). Base holds mid-cycle ~16.5%: premiumisation and vehicle mix offset thin handset gross margins (~14.7%).
base.capex_rationale: Total capex 6.8% FY2025, 7.5% of revenue in H1 2026 (overseas Vietnam/India capacity); glides to 6.0%, above D&A 5.5% to fund ~2-4% growth.
base.cash_tax_rationale: Combined cash tax + NCI leakage (see inputs.nci_treatment): HNTE 15% rate less R&D super-deduction gave ~11-12% effective tax FY2025/H1 2026, ramping to 14%; NCI share 6%.
base.wc_rationale: Manufacturer: receivables+FVTOCI receivables+inventory (~RMB16.4bn) roughly match payables, but growth consumed cash (FY2024 ~-26%, FY2025 ~-7% of the revenue increase). -10% of incremental revenue.

scenario_narratives.base: Handset (63% of revenue) is flat-to-low-single-digit: global smartphone units decline in 2026 on memory-chip-driven price rises, but Sunny keeps its No.1 lens-set and module share and premiumisation (periscope, 200MP, large aperture) lifts ASP enough to hold handset revenue roughly level. Growth comes from vehicle optics (ADAS camera count, L3 rollout in China, LiDAR optics) and Pan-IoT/robotics, with AI-glasses XR growth offset by the MR decline. Revenue +9% in FY2026 decaying to ~3.5%; pre-SBC EBITDA margin settles at a mid-cycle 16.5%; capex eases from the overseas-capacity build to 6% of revenue; the vehicle spin-off IPO lifts NCI leakage modestly.
scenario_narratives.bull: Vehicle optics becomes a second core business: China L3 approvals and camera/LiDAR content per vehicle compound vehicle revenue at 20%+, AI/AR glasses scale into a real category where the Goertek Optical tie-up gives Sunny the leading lens and optical-engine supply, and robotics vision (lawn mowers, AMR, humanoids) adds a third leg. Handset premiumisation continues and domestic substitution favours the scaled Chinese champion. Revenue grows 12% for two years and stays high-single-digit to year 5; mix lifts EBITDA margin toward the FY2020-21 range (18%).
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2026 smartphone volume decline deepens and Android OEMs squeeze component pricing to absorb memory-cost inflation; a top customer re-sources modules to Q Technology/OFILM or in-house, handset gross margin compresses from ~14.7%, and US export controls on advanced optics/LiDAR cap the vehicle and XR upside. FY2027 revenue stalls (+1%), EBITDA margin falls back to the FY2023-24 trough range (~14%), and the vehicle spin-off moves a larger share of the growth engine's profit to minority holders (leakage rising to ~23%).

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: revenue is concentrated in a handful of Android OEMs in a declining unit market, and US-China export-control risk on optics/LiDAR is a single-regulator exposure outside management's control. Base 50%: H1 2026 (+11.5% revenue, ~16% margin) is tracking the base path. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent things to go right at once -- vehicle content compounding, AI-glasses scaling, and handset margin holding.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A mid-cycle owner-FCF valuation of a cyclical Chinese optics manufacturer. The headline rests on three judgments: (1) the RMB20.7bn liquidity pile (mostly bank wealth-management products) counts as net cash less a RMB3bn operating float, worth ~RMB10.8/share; (2) the RMB919m Goertek share-swap gain is excluded from the margin base (it never entered FCF); (3) margins normalise at ~16.5% pre-SBC rather than the 19-20% FY2020-21 peak. SBC is small (0.5% of revenue) so house and street values sit close together.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash treatment: counting the full RMB20.7bn with no operating float adds ~RMB2.8/share (~HK$3.3); treating all WMPs as operating subtracts ~RMB12/share.
PRC repatriation: dividend withholding on moving the cash pile to the Cayman parent (5-10%) is not haircut.
Terminal value is capped at 12x FCF in the base; cyclical hardware peers have traded below that at troughs.
Vehicle spin-off (Sunny Smart Autotech) could move more profit to NCI than the 6% leakage assumed.
Associates carried at book (Goertek Optical stake marked at swap-date fair value Dec-2025); no market check.
